== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Tatooine: Mos Eisley (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (<code>1210_73</code>, Virtual Block 1 slip 71), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. Drawn without the Interior icon on either side; the game text is unchanged.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post p874174 by Lukes Bionic Hand, 27 March 2014: https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p874174 (“The Interior icon on both sides of this location is considered stricken.”)
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “'''Dark Side:''' Once per turn, when a player's Landing Craft takes off or lands here, that player may retrieve 1 Force '''Light Side:''' Immune to Revolution. If a stormtrooper here, you must first use 2 Force to deploy a weapon or device at same or adjacent site.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card, with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB1-71-Tatooine_Mos_Eisley_Dark-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B41 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
